pivot.description: Ground origin; see notes for module placement

notes: VSP grapevine tile; exactly 3m along +Y; ground start-end origin. Two vines at Y=.75/2.25m and one wooden post occupying Y=0..0.07m.
Closed recessed inner canopy from .92 to 1.70m; detailed five-lobed green leaf clusters cover sides/top to approx 1.8m. Three wires; no mask, wind or collision.

Separate final LOD has a slightly expanded closed canopy to stand in for the detailed leaf envelope, plus post, two trunks, cordons and wires. Explicitly assign it as the receiving mesh lowest LOD; importing it as an unrelated mesh is insufficient.
All seven material slots retained in both LODs: bark0, post1, wire2, leaf3, leaf_light4, canopy5, grape6.
Translate tiles by exact 3m pitch. Identical canopy end profiles across A/B/C; internal end caps coincide on a plane only, with no positive-volume inter-tile overlap.

notes: Original grey-green olive with curved narrow lanceolate leaves, pale undersides, twisted split trunk and irregular open crown.
18 recessed opaque closed crown clumps and 7,200 closed leaf volumes.
Material slot names/order identical in high and low mesh, including unused leaf slots in LOD3. All foliage alpha1, opaque two-sided; no wind or collision.
Trunk-base ground origin; metres; -Y FBX forward, Z up. Native integration and distant appearance remain for the operator.

Pivot at ground centre; metres; FBX -Y forward / Z up. No wind or collision.
No alpha cards. BaseColor alpha=1; opaque two-sided materials. Normal OpenGL +Y.
LOD3 uses independent expanded closed tuft proxies to replace the fine blade coverage; LOD0 keeps smaller inner backing tufts.
Fitted hero preview is not a fixed-distance preview; root supplies separate distance frames.
